# Tooltip

A short hint on hover or focus.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Readers arrive on any device, and on touch screens hover hints never show. Icons always carry a visible word instead. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a>, <a href="./label">Label</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A brief name or hint for a control that already has an accessible name.
- **Not when:** The only place values or important words live, or touch screens, where hover never happens.

Instead:

- [Popover](./popover.md): Opens on click and works on touch.
- [Hover card](./hover-card.md): A richer preview.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An icon with no label</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Not used: always add a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon button</div></div><div class="cap">Occasional visitors do not know icons.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape hides it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It describes its trigger and also shows on keyboard focus. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add tooltip
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
